gaps.why: Hovering produced no tooltip element. Either the directive is not bound on this build, the control is off-screen, or the events it listens for differ. Nothing has been invented for it.

gaps.what: title= tooltips are the browser own
gaps.why: 60 elements use a native title attribute. The OS draws those and no script can capture their appearance — the text is recorded, the rendering is not ours to match.
